name: pulse-chat
description: Pulse - a real-time chat app built with React, Socket.IO and Express.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n SERVER,CLIENT -c blue,magenta "npm run server" "npm run client"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.build: npm install --prefix client --include=dev && npm run build --prefix client
